items.title: Allianz loses Court of Appeal bid over "imminent" threat in cladding dispute
items.summary: The Court of Appeal has ruled that Vivid Housing Limited's latent defects claim over combustible cladding and missing cavity barriers must proceed to trial.

items.title: Gallagher appoints Austen Robilliard as investment portfolio solutions director
items.summary: Global broker Gallagher has recruited former Titan Wealth executive Austen Robilliard to bolster its UK wealth offering.

items.title: Record flooding hits north Georgia with many property owners lacking flood cover
items.summary: Severe flash flooding in north Georgia has caused widespread property damage, though local insurance agents report that most affected owners lacked flood coverage.

items.title: FCA warns against unauthorised First Islamic Cooperative Investment Bank PLC
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has issued a warning against First Islamic Cooperative Investment Bank PLC for operating without regulatory permission in the UK.

items.title: Liontrust plans fee cuts on three funds after red ratings
items.summary: Investment Week reports that Liontrust is reducing ongoing charges across four share classes following its 2026 Assessment of Value report.

items.title: AM Best revises Premia Re Europe rating status to developing
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that AM Best has changed the under review status of Premia Re Europe to developing following its acquisition by Premia Holdings.
